entities.name: Hench
entities.description: A small trade post town in Yotia on the road from Kroog toward Korlis; later submerged beneath the Sea of Laments.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The capital city of Yotia that fell in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: An Avenger who traveled to Hench after his squad died.

entities.name: Rica
entities.description: An Avenger who traveled to Hench after her squad died.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: The event during which Hench served as a meeting place for refugees.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: The flood that inundated Hench's land.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: The sea beneath which Hench was submerged.

events.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Hench becomes a meeting place where refugees and wounded gather to find each other.
events.quote: where refugees and wounded gathered to find each other

events.summary: Sanwell and Rica travel to Hench after the death of the rest of their Avenger squad.
events.quote: Sanwell and Rica traveled to Hench

events.summary: Hench's land is inundated in the Flooding of Terisiare and submerged beneath the Sea of Laments.
events.quote: inundated in the Flooding of Terisiare
